criteria: Make NTS archive browsing compact and easy to navigate at chat-card widths, with a bounded visible result page and reduced repeated per-row details.
Provide a clear route from a show episode list back to the prior search without losing query/results; distinguish shows and episodes and keep NTS links accessible.
Keep the active player and explicit playback controls accessible without browsing/searching stopping or changing audio; coordinate cleanly with DIAL-013 pending-live-selection behavior.
Preserve existing API request bounds, exact media/CSP policy, signed URL isolation, playback/seek/retry and stale-response guards.
Independent Review and Verify use exact candidate and realistic rendered narrow/desktop checks; do not infer actual host rendering from source or a mock alone.

events.title: Make NTS archive browsing compact and navigable

events.reason: Owner requests bounded cleanup of functioning archive UI. Concrete criteria and triage define five-row local pagination, search/show Back navigation and selected-item details; no new API/media/trust scope or broad design change.

objective: Respond to owner host feedback: archive search works but layout is too long. Reduce visible density, add clear search/show navigation and keep player controls easy to reach without changing media trust or API scope.

reports.complexity: Medium, bounded UI state and layout change: maintain search results/query and selected show context, add a five-item visible page with local Previous/Next, and use one selected-item detail area for metadata and its NTS link. Keep accessible keyboard controls and retain current safe URL filtering and response guards. A visual check is needed at chat-card/narrow width and desktop width.
evidence: Owner dispatch reports archive search works, but layout is long; it identifies 12 mixed results, metadata, repeated per-row Open on NTS links, and no Back from a show's episodes.

The source caps each returned archive list at 12 (src/player.ts:106) but renders all accepted items in one pass (src/player.ts:108-132), with a subline for type/show/date and sometimes audio availability (src/player.ts:112).

Selecting a show clears/replaces the visible result list with its episode response, and no prior result list or query route is stored (src/player.ts:114-120). The query input is not cleared, but there is no in-app Back control.

Every result row appends an external NTS link (src/player.ts:130-131). The shared player section follows the archive panel in the document (public/discovery.html); a long result list can put its controls below the fold.

The archive search and show loading paths call supersede() and update archive state; they do not directly call player.stop(). Episode selection does call player.selectStation() (src/player.ts:122-128), so testing should separate passive browse/search from the explicit episode-selection action.
The live-channel click path is independent at src/player.ts:84-97 and is the subject of the separate DIAL-013 implementation.
relevant_code: public/discovery.html: the NTS panel places archive search and the full result list above the shared player; each archive item currently has its own Open on NTS link.

src/player.ts:98-132: showArchive filters safe aliases/URLs, takes up to 12 items, renders every item with metadata and an external link, and replaces the list with episodes after selecting a show without retaining a back route.
src/player.ts:134-144: search keeps the query in the input, invokes the bounded search tool, and displays results; current request generation guards should remain intact.

src/player.ts:114-129: show selection loads episodes; episode selection updates the shared player selection and episode link. This behavior needs regression coverage while layout/navigation changes are made.
factory/work-items/DIAL-013/reports/run-fb176dfb8689.json: DIAL-013 separately addresses non-destructive NTS live-channel preparation; do not modify or conflate its pending/active selection behavior.
risks: Replacing results for a show without preserving query and prior page would make Back lose context or return to stale results after a newer search.
Putting the only external NTS link behind an inaccessible or ambiguous interaction would reduce link discoverability; detail selection must be keyboard reachable and clearly labeled.

Moving/hiding the shared player or wiring archive interactions through player selection could interrupt audio or make Pause hard to reach. Browsing, searching, pagination, and show navigation should not change playback; episode selection should retain its explicit current semantics unless separately specified.

The current source has inline theme styles, and no actual host rendering evidence is present in this triage. Review/Verify should inspect realistic narrow and desktop rendered layouts and report host limits honestly.
reports.scope: Read-only investigation of archive result density, show-to-episode navigation, and player reachability. No production or lifecycle files were edited.
reports.spec_skip_reason: The request describes a bounded routine polish and the dispatch gives measurable behaviors: show about five rows at once, provide local paging, preserve query/results on Back, keep NTS links accessible through selected-item details, and keep shared playback controls usable without browse/search changing audio. These choices can be implemented without a new provider, media policy, or API behavior. Validate the page size and navigation on narrow chat-card and desktop layouts.
